# Every fixture in this directory, where it came from, and when.
#
# Nothing here is hand written. Each file is the bytes arXiv served for the URL
# in its row, saved unedited, so a test that parses a fixture is parsing what
# arXiv actually says rather than what somebody remembered it saying. The date
# is when the bytes were read, and it is there because a fixture with no date is
# a claim with no age.
#
# capture_test.go reads this file and checks it both ways: a fixture with no row
# fails, and a row with no fixture fails.
#
# Four columns, tab separated: the file, the surface id from doc 01, the date it
# was read, and the URL it was read from.
